name: Darkling beetle (Onymacris plana)
description: The darkling beetle Onymacris plana - a big, fast, heat-tolerant beetle of the dune surface and the fog oases; the mixing model credits scale insects (89%) but also smaller prey (barklice 45%... shared with litter sources - it is the web's most omnivorous consumer), and it is classic prey of the sand lizards and the dune lark. Species node matching the source's Onymacris plana taxon.
